items.label: Capture Project Control, terminology, Editor roadmap, and owner repository context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, product terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, and old Editor roadmap Task 7 are reviewed before implementation.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-8h, owner repository repo-editor, phase target phase-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-table-authoring-gate, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-core-backend-editor-readiness-pass-editor-table-authoring-gate, and evidence target evidence-editor-table-authoring-gate-2026-08-31 before record edits.

items.label: Write failing Editor and Project Control tests before accepting the Table authoring gate.
items.evidenceTarget: Table boundary, misleading table descendant add actions, Paper/projection table facts, Inspector table context, and Project Control registration fail before implementation or record edits.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included tableAuthoringBoundary failing because the module did not exist, nodePresentation/Paper tests failing because table ids were absent from represented text descendants, addNodeVisibleActions failing because selected detail-cell-a-text still exposed ready Text/Columns actions after Metric, and Project Control Work Queue failing because this phase was not registered.

items.label: Resolve table, row, cell, and table text selections into explicit read-only boundary facts.
items.evidenceTarget: Table, table-row, table-cell, and table text descendants expose tableId/tableRowId/tableCellId/textBlockId plus selectionLevel without mutating state.
items.verificationNote: tableAuthoringBoundary tests prove detail-table, detail-header-row, detail-cell-a, and detail-cell-a-text resolve to table, row, cell, and cell-text levels while remaining blocked.

items.label: Keep unsupported table structure authoring blocked with one exact reason.
items.evidenceTarget: Insert/delete row and insert/delete column intents return blocked facts until Backend/Core table mutation operations are advertised.
items.verificationNote: tableAuthoringBoundary blockedIntents return insert-row, delete-row, insert-column, and delete-column with the exact reason Table authoring is gated until Backend/Core advertise table mutation operations.

items.label: Prevent selected table descendants from exposing ready add actions that imply table-cell authoring is available.
items.evidenceTarget: Selected detail-cell-a-text no longer produces ready Text/Columns add actions after the represented Table surface.
items.verificationNote: addNodeVisibleActions tests prove selected detail-cell-a-text returns a disabled Text action targeting detail-cell-a context with the table gate reason and does not expose columns.insert.

items.label: Expose table context in Inspector and Paper markup without claiming authoring readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Inspector shows table authoring boundary only for table contexts, and Paper table preview text descendants expose table, row, and cell ids.
items.verificationNote: Inspector, nodePresentation, and PaperBlock tests prove Cell text context and data-canvas-table-id/data-canvas-table-row-id/data-canvas-table-cell-id are present while contenteditable and implicit textarea authoring are not introduced by this slice.

items.label: Run Editor worktree and merged-main gates, record Project Control evidence, and keep maps unchanged.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused Editor tests, full Editor check, no-write live Backend smoke, and Project Control record tests support the bounded evidence record.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree and merged main passed focused 10-file/45-test gate, npm run check with 105 test files and 381 tests plus build, and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke. Project Control records are added without map promotion.
